readme:
# OLX.pl Scraper

Scrape classified listings from [OLX.pl](https://www.olx.pl), a Polish classifieds marketplace.

## How it works

1. Go to [olx.pl](https://www.olx.pl), search and set your filters (category, city, price)
2. Copy the search URL and paste it into `searchUrls`
3. Run the actor

The actor extracts all listings matching your search, with automatic pagination.

### Supported URLs

- Category pages, with the filters from the URL: `https://www.olx.pl/motoryzacja/samochody/audi/?search%5Bfilter_float_price:from%5D=20000`
- Keyword pages, with or without a category: `https://www.olx.pl/oferty/q-iphone/`, `https://www.olx.pl/elektronika/telefony/q-iphone/`
- Category pages with a city: `https://www.olx.pl/nieruchomosci/mieszkania/sprzedaz/warszawa/`

A URL that cannot be matched to an OLX category or city is skipped. The log and the run status name it, and no listings are returned for it.

## Use with AI Agents (MCP)

Connect this actor to any MCP-compatible AI client: Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, Cursor, VS Code, LangChain, LlamaIndex, or custom agents.

**Apify MCP server URL:**

```
https://mcp.apify.com?tools=santamaria-automations/olx-pl-scraper
```

**Example prompt once connected:**

> "Use `olx-pl-scraper` to scrape company data from olx pl. Return results as a table."

Clients that support dynamic tool discovery (Claude.ai, VS Code) will receive the full input schema automatically via `add-actor`.

## Output

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `title` | Listing title |
| `description` | Full description |
| `price` / `currency` | Price in PLN or EUR; also filled when the seller marks the price as negotiable |
| `price_negotiable` | `true` when the offer is marked "do uzgodnienia" (negotiable), `false` for a fixed price, empty when there is no price |
| `category` / `category_path` | Top-level category type; `category_path` is the list of category names from the top level down, e.g. `["Elektronika", "Telefony", "Smartfony i telefony komórkowe", "iPhone"]` |
| `condition` | Item condition (for cars taken from the `condition` attribute) |
| `params` | Listing attributes as an object, e.g. `{"phonemodel": "iPhone 11", "builtinmemory_phones": "64GB", "coloriphone": "Czarny"}`; the keys depend on the category |
| `city` / `region` | Location details |
| `latitude` / `longitude` | GPS coordinates |
| `seller_name` / `seller_type` | Seller info (private/business) |
| `image_url` / `image_urls` | Images |
| `posted_at` | Publication date |
| `source_url` | Link to listing on OLX.pl |

## Pricing

| Event | Cost |
|-------|------|
| Start | $0.001 per run |
| Listing | $0.002 per listing |

**100 listings = $0.201** | **1,000 listings = $2.001**

## Examples

### iPhones
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.olx.pl/elektronika/telefony/q-iphone/"
  ],
  "maxResults": 50
}
```

### Several searches in one run
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.olx.pl/elektronika/telefony/q-iphone/",
    "https://www.olx.pl/motoryzacja/samochody/audi/"
  ],
  "maxResults": 200,
  "maxResultsPerQuery": 80
}
```

### Cars with filters
```json
{
  "searchUrls": [
    "https://www.olx.pl/motoryzacja/samochody/audi/?search%5Bfilter_enum_model%5D%5B0%5D=a5-sportback&search%5Bfilter_float_milage:to%5D=1000"
  ],
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

## Data protection

This actor returns only data that is publicly visible on the source pages. Results can include personal data, such as names, phone numbers, email addresses and addresses of private persons, sole traders or contact persons. Where the source labels an entry type, it is included so you can filter the results yourself.

You are responsible for using the data lawfully, including the GDPR/DSGVO, national data-protection laws and unfair-competition rules (e.g. UWG) for marketing and outreach.

Missing something or not working as expected? [Open an issue](https://console.apify.com/actors/hw9mhkHXXwgqdakMB/issues) and we'll fix it.
